blocker_title: Cannot Read Branch Protection Rules - HTTP 403
blocker_description: LP-cleanup-004 requires reading branch protection data for all protected branches before proceeding with hygiene classification. The GitHub token (ghu_*) does not have permission to access branch protection rules.

precondition_failed.requirement: Must be able to read branch protection for protected branches

why_blocking: Branch protection status is REQUIRED to classify branches safely
Cannot determine if a branch is protected before proposing deletion
Risk of proposing deletion of protected branches without protection data
LP-cleanup-004 specification requires protection data as precondition
Deterministic rules cannot be applied without knowing protection status

impact.cannot_proceed_until: GitHub token granted branch protection read access OR repo maintainer provides protection JSON

required_permissions.current_scopes: Unknown (GitHub Actions token ghu_* with default permissions)

resolution_options.title: Grant Token Read Access to Branch Protection
steps: Navigate to GitHub Actions token settings
Add 'read:org' or 'admin:org' scope (read-only for branch protection)
Or use a PAT (Personal Access Token) with 'repo' scope
resolution_options.notes: Preferred solution - allows automated branch protection checks

resolution_options.title: Manual Branch Protection Export
steps: Repo maintainer exports branch protection rules manually
Generate JSON with: gh api /repos/twgallo13/ROPI-V2.1/branches/{branch}/protection > protection.json
Run for all protected branches (aoss-main, main, etc.)
resolution_options.notes: Workaround if token permissions cannot be changed

resolution_options.title: Skip Protection Verification (NOT RECOMMENDED)
steps: Mark all branches as 'unknown protection status'
Flag for manual review before any deletion
resolution_options.notes: UNSAFE - increases risk of proposing protected branch deletion

request_to_lisa:
Please authorize one of the resolution options:

1. Grant read:org scope to GitHub token (RECOMMENDED)
2. Provide manual branch protection export
3. Authorize skip (NOT RECOMMENDED - unsafe)

Once resolved, I will immediately proceed with LP-cleanup-004 branch hygiene identification.
workaround_description: Option 2: Manual branch protection export by repo maintainer
